name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement the SWAP test in Qiskit to estimate
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement the SWAP test in Qiskit to estimate |<psi|phi>|^2 between RY(1.388)|0> and RY(2.341)|0>. Compare the estimate from 16384 shots with the analytic overlap cos^2((1.388-2.341)/2). Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
